title: Tiny, cute magnifying glass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- lens glass -->
    <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='22' fill='#8fe3ff' opacity='0.55'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#ffe14d' stroke-width='6'/>
    <!-- lens rim highlight -->
    <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='25' fill='none' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.9'/>
    <!-- glass shine -->
    <path d='M31 30 Q37 23 46 24' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='34' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- handle -->
    <rect x='59' y='56' width='12' height='27' rx='6' fill='#ff5fa2' transform='rotate(-45 65 69)'/>
    <rect x='62' y='59' width='4' height='20' rx='2' fill='#ff9ec8' transform='rotate(-45 65 69)'/>
    <!-- handle cap -->
    <circle cx='82' cy='80' r='7' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
    <circle cx='80' cy='78' r='2.5' fill='#ffc4dd'/>
  </g>
</svg>
